authoring: Drafted with AI assistance (Claude) from the normalized page text; every evidence_quote verified by src.run.verify_benchmark to exist on its gold page(s). Student must review before submission.
corpus: hp-complete-collection-pottermore, Books 1-3, PDF physical page numbers
selection_rule_fixed_before_test: Choose the strategy with the highest dev Evidence Hit@3; ties -> higher dev Hit@1 -> fewer chunks / lower embed time. Test is run once after the choice is fixed and is reported, not tuned on.
filter_semantics: filter is a user-context input supplied before retrieval (the reader states which book they are reading). It narrows to a whole book (~280-370 pages), never to the gold page or answer. Strategy C applies it; A and B ignore it. Questions without filter run unfiltered in C.

questions.question: What did the company Mr. Dursley directed make?
questions.expected_answer: Drills (the firm was called Grunnings).
questions.evidence_quote: Mr. Dursley was the director of a firm called Grunnings, which made drills.

questions.question: How much money did Harry hand over to Mr. Ollivander for his wand?
questions.expected_answer: Seven gold Galleons.
questions.evidence_quote: He paid seven gold Galleons for his wand

questions.question: Which Gringotts vault held the mysterious package Hagrid collected on Hogwarts business?
questions.expected_answer: Vault seven hundred and thirteen (713).
questions.evidence_quote: the You-Know-What in vault seven hundred and thirteen

alt_evidence.quote: What's the You-Know-What in vault seven hundred and thirteen?
Hagrid had emptied vault seven hundred and thirteen, if you could call it emptying, taking out that grubby little package.

questions.question: According to Dumbledore, what does the Mirror of Erised actually reveal to the person looking into it?
questions.expected_answer: Nothing more or less than the deepest, most desperate desire of their heart.
questions.evidence_quote: It shows us nothing more or less than the deepest, most desperate desire of our hearts.

questions.question: What did Hermione discover Nicolas Flamel is famous for?
questions.expected_answer: He is the only known maker of the Sorcerer's Stone.
questions.evidence_quote: is the only known maker of the Sorcerer's Stone!

questions.question: How did Hermione manage to attend all of her lessons during the year?
questions.expected_answer: She used a Time-Turner that Professor McGonagall gave her on the first day back.
questions.evidence_quote: It's called a Time-Turner," Hermione whispered, "and I got it from Professor McGonagall on our first day back. I've been using it all year to get to all my lessons.

questions.question: Under what condition can a house-elf like Dobby be set free?
questions.expected_answer: Only if his masters present him with clothes (the family avoids passing him even a sock).
questions.evidence_quote: Dobby can only be freed if his masters present him with clothes, sir.

questions.question: When the barrier to the platform would not let them through, how did Ron propose they get to school?
questions.expected_answer: By flying Mr. Weasley's car to Hogwarts.
questions.evidence_quote: We can fly the car to Hogwarts!

questions.question: How did Tom Riddle show Harry that he and Lord Voldemort are the same person?
questions.expected_answer: He wrote TOM MARVOLO RIDDLE in the air with Harry's wand and rearranged the letters into I AM LORD VOLDEMORT.
questions.evidence_quote: the letters of his name rearranged themselves: I AM LORD VOLDEMORT

questions.question: What item did Lucius Malfoy unknowingly give Dobby that set him free?
questions.expected_answer: A sock (Harry's sock, which Malfoy threw aside and Dobby caught).
questions.evidence_quote: Master has given a sock," said the elf in wonderment. "Master gave it to Dobby.

questions.question: What does Lupin say ultimately defeats a boggart?
questions.expected_answer: Laughter: forcing it to take a shape you find amusing (with the Riddikulus charm).
questions.evidence_quote: the thing that really finishes a boggart is laughter. What you need to do is force it to assume a shape that you find amusing.

questions.question: What incantation does Lupin teach Harry for producing a Patronus?
questions.expected_answer: Expecto patronum!
questions.evidence_quote: The incantation is this -" Lupin cleared his throat. "Expecto patronum!

questions.question: What password let the students into Gryffindor Tower at the start of the year?
questions.expected_answer: Caput Draconis.
questions.evidence_quote: "Password?" she said. "Caput Draconis," said Percy, and the portrait swung forward

questions.question: Harry got an unsigned Christmas present this year. What was it and what did the note say?
questions.expected_answer: An Invisibility Cloak; the note said his father left it in the sender's possession, it was time it was returned, and to use it well.
questions.evidence_quote: pulled off the cloak and seized the letter. Written in narrow, loopy writing he had never seen before were the following words: Your father left this in my possession before he died. It is time it was returned to you. Use it well.

questions.question: Who did Dumbledore announce as the new Defense Against the Dark Arts teacher at the start-of-term feast?
questions.expected_answer: Professor Lupin.
questions.evidence_quote: Professor Lupin, who has kindly consented to fill the post of Defense Against the Dark Arts teacher.

questions.question: What birthday present did Hagrid send Harry this year?
questions.expected_answer: The Monster Book of Monsters (a biting book), with a card saying it would be useful next year.
questions.evidence_quote: emblazoned with the golden title The Monster Book of Monsters

alt_evidence.quote: The Monster Book shuddered angrily, but could no longer flap and snap, so Harry threw it down on the bed and reached for Hagrid's card. Dear Harry, Happy birthday! Think you might find this useful for next year.

questions.question: Which broomstick model arrived for Harry in a parcel, and why was he told to keep it quiet?
questions.expected_answer: A Nimbus Two Thousand; the sender did not want everybody knowing he had a broomstick or they would all want one.
questions.evidence_quote: It contains your new Nimbus Two Thousand, but I don't want everybody knowing you've got a broomstick or they'll all want one.

questions.question: What service does the Knight Bus provide, and how do you call it?
questions.expected_answer: Emergency transport for stranded witches or wizards; stick out your wand hand and step on board.
questions.evidence_quote: Welcome to the Knight Bus, emergency transport for the stranded witch or wizard. Just stick out your wand hand, step on board, and we can take you anywhere you want to go.

questions.question: What is the only thing a basilisk runs away from, and what does it do to the creature?
questions.expected_answer: The crowing of a rooster, which is fatal to it.
questions.evidence_quote: the basilisk flees only from the crowing of the rooster, which is fatal to it

alt_evidence.quote: the basilisk flees only from the crowing of the rooster, which is fatal to it

questions.question: Under what condition could someone get the Stone out of the Mirror of Erised?
questions.expected_answer: Only someone who wanted to find the Stone but not use it could get it; others would just see themselves making gold or drinking the Elixir of Life.
questions.evidence_quote: only one who wanted to find the Stone - find it, but not use it - would be able to get it, otherwise they'd just see themselves making gold or drinking Elixir of Life.
